page.overview:
Who is Abel Tarrant?

Abel Tarrant was created by Gardner Fox and Gil Kane, first appearing in (1963). John Oakes was created by Jerry Prosser and Warren Pleece under the Vertigo title, first appearing in (1993). Mark Richards was created by Geoff Johns and Ethan Van Sciver, first appearing in (2006).
